name: Curated Python refactoring dataset (authored)
provenance: Authored/synthetic: generated by scripts/generate_curated_dataset.py from parametric templates. Not scraped from real repositories and not human-annotated. Suitable for pipeline validation and LoRA training smoke tests; conclusions must not be presented as real-world dataset evidence (NFR06). Clean-control records are identity pairs and are labelled as such.

verification_policy.golden-equivalence: Auto-synthesized golden tests compare completion vs prompt behaviour on sampled inputs inside the isolated sandbox (NFR01/NFR02).
verification_policy.authored-smoke-test: Signature-changing parameter-object refactors are verified by an authored smoke test proving the new API works as intended.
verification_policy.clean-control: Identity pairs whose prompt the analyzer reports as finding-free; the completion is the same module. No code is executed because there is no behavioural change to compare.

equivalence_not_applicable.long-parameter-list: The parameter-object refactor intentionally changes the call surface (one request object instead of six scalars); golden equivalence against the old signature is therefore not applicable. Verified by the authored smoke test instead.

prompt_marker: No provenance comment is embedded in prompts: training and inference must see the same code. Provenance lives in id/source_group and this manifest.
